fork.question: Whether two readers have named the same crux or different cruxes

data.reason: Both options name the same crux in different words: a cure that must remain undecidably ruinous, held in three equally weighted closing answers, and a faux-scholarly, detached Chinese-tale voice whose distance makes the one passage of bodily torment work. Option 1 states that twin crux most cleanly, with its evidence tied to the text and without turning either reader's useful directing details into a second, competing crux.
data.say: House log: The two independent readings were judged to name the same crux, and Option 1 was picked as the wording to go forward.
